name: M3_MMS120MI_UpdDetAlloc
description:
Update detailed allocation quantities for an existing order line and its stock identity. This operation adjusts how much of a specific warehouse, location, and optionally lot and container is reserved against one or more orders once detailed allocation already exists, typically after picking has been released.

It works at material-plan level and follows the same rules as the interactive allocation functions. You can increase or reduce the reserved quantity for a line, and optionally move allocated quantity between an order you deallocate from and an order you allocate to. It supports different order categories such as distribution, manufacturing, and work orders, depending on the stock transaction type configuration.

inputParameters.name: WHLO
inputParameters.description: Warehouse where the detailed allocation to be updated is registered.

inputParameters.name: ITNO
inputParameters.description: Item number for the product whose detailed allocation is being updated.

inputParameters.name: WHSL
inputParameters.description: Stock location in the warehouse that holds the allocated balance to be updated.

inputParameters.name: ALQT
inputParameters.description: Quantity to be allocated or deallocated in the item's basic unit of measure.

inputParameters.name: BANO
inputParameters.description: Lot number identifying the specific lot from which the allocated quantity is updated.

inputParameters.name: CAMU
inputParameters.description: Container number identifying the container from which the allocated quantity is updated, when container-managed.

inputParameters.name: TTYP
inputParameters.description: Stock transaction type for the order line to which the allocation will be increased or moved.

inputParameters.name: RIDN
inputParameters.description: Order number for the order whose allocation will be increased or moved to.

inputParameters.name: RIDL
inputParameters.description: Order line number on the order whose allocation will be increased or moved to.

inputParameters.name: RIDX
inputParameters.description: Line suffix identifying the subline or sequence on the order line whose allocation will be increased or moved to.

inputParameters.name: TTYD
inputParameters.description: Stock transaction type for the order line from which the allocation will be reduced or removed.

inputParameters.name: RIDD
inputParameters.description: Order number for the order whose allocation will be reduced or removed.

inputParameters.name: RILD
inputParameters.description: Order line number on the order whose allocation will be reduced or removed.

inputParameters.name: RIXD
inputParameters.description: Line suffix identifying the subline or sequence on the order line whose allocation will be reduced or removed.
